reporting-org.narrative: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development

description.narrative: Provision of a USD 8.8 million loan to KbW Investments accompanied by a potential Finance and Technology Transfer Centre for Climate Change ("FINTECC") grant of up to EUR 0.4 million. The proceeds of the Bank's investment will be used to finance the supply and installation of new energy-efficient Light Emitting Diodes ("LED") that would replace old energy-inefficient street lighting fixtures and/or increase street lighting coverage in underserved areas in Jordan (the "Project"). The Project will finance an Energy Performance Contract ("Enpc") and an LED supply contract that KbW Investments has secured in Jordan. The Project contributes to climate change mitigation as it is expected to result in: i) up to c. 4,623 tCO2e reductions, ii) 50% reduction in energy consumption, iii) improved level of services in Project catchment areas, by increasing street lighting coverage from 60-70% up to 100%, and iv) increase in the penetration rate of LED technology in rural areas in Jordan.
